name: orchestrate
description: Run a multi-session job as its orchestrator: plan, brief worker sessions, monitor, verify their claims, and loop the human in only for decisions.

interface.longDescription: Plan a job, give workers separate ownership, and verify their reports. Requires a local coding environment with worker or subagent capabilities. Supports Claude Code and Codex through runtime-specific guidance; cannot launch workers in plain Chat without those capabilities.
defaultPrompt: Use $orchestrate to plan and coordinate this job across workers.
